sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你制作了终极版《办公室》重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会剖析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。
今天这集是《安迪的祖先》。

sentences.en: What are we going to find out?
We're going to find out a lot.
This episode was written by Jonathan Green and Gabe Miller.
sentences.zh: 这一集由乔纳森·格林和盖比·米勒编剧。

sentences.en: This is a new writer alert.
They were a new writing team for this season.
sentences.zh: 他们是这一季的新编剧团队。

sentences.en: Before joining The Office, they had written on The Class and Late Show with David Letterman.
sentences.zh: 在加入《办公室》之前，他们曾为《班级》和《大卫·莱特曼深夜秀》写过剧本。

sentences.en: And after The Office, they worked on The Cleveland Show, The Mindy Project, Superstore, and American Auto.
sentences.zh: 在《办公室》之后，他们还参与了《克利夫兰秀》、《明迪烦事多》、《爆笑超市》和《美国汽车》的制作。

sentences.en: And they were really nice guys.
This episode was directed by Dave Rogers.
sentences.zh: 这一集由戴夫·罗杰斯执导。

sentences.en: Anders, would you like a summary?
sentences.zh: 安德斯，你想要剧情梗概吗？

sentences.en: I really would because then I have some call sheet information for you.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想要，因为这样我就可以为你提供一些通告单信息了。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm loving you and these call sheets.
sentences.zh: 噢，我真是爱死你和这些通告单了。

sentences.en: You didn't read them when we were on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们拍戏的时候你可从不看它们。

sentences.en: I literally, I stepped over them.
sentences.zh: 我真的，我甚至直接跨过它们。

sentences.en: They would put them by our doors.
sentences.zh: 他们会把通告单放在我们的门边。

sentences.en: They would slide them under and I would be like, why are these papers?
sentences.zh: 他们会从门缝塞进来，而我当时心想，这些纸是干嘛的？

sentences.en: I would read them front and back.
sentences.zh: 我会把它们从头到尾读一遍。

sentences.en: Pam, I'm so excited you're into the call sheets, Ange, 20 years later.
sentences.zh: 帕姆，我真高兴你20年后终于对通告单感兴趣了，安吉。

sentences.en: Don't ever give up on yourself, people.
sentences.zh: 大家千万不要放弃自己。

sentences.en: You have it in you to discover new things about yourself.
sentences.zh: 你们有能力去发现关于自己的新事物。

sentences.en: Here is your summary for this episode.
sentences.zh: 这是这一集的剧情梗概。

sentences.en: Nellie retaliates against Andy's bullying by falsifying his family tree.
sentences.zh: 奈莉伪造了安迪的家谱，以此反击安迪对她的霸凌。

sentences.en: Erin learns a new language in order to impress Andy and his family.
sentences.zh: 艾琳为了给安迪和他的家人留下好印象，开始学习一门新语言。

sentences.en: Pam helps Nellie practice driving for her upcoming driving teSt.
sentences.zh: 帕姆帮助奈莉练习驾驶，准备迎接即将到来的驾照考试。

sentences.en: And Daryl helps Jim come clean with the secret that he's been keeping from Pam.
sentences.zh: 达里尔帮助吉姆坦白了他一直瞒着帕姆的秘密。

sentences.en: Angela, I have fast facts, but do you need to hit us with your call sheet delights first?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我准备了速记事实，但你是不是得先给我们分享一下你的通告单趣事？

sentences.en: I would like to just set the temperature for the week for everybody.
sentences.zh: 我想先给各位定一下这周的基调。

sentences.en: Are you going to continue to tell us the weather?
sentences.zh: 你这是要继续给我们播报天气吗？

sentences.en: I'm like, how your parents just have the weather channel on all the time?
sentences.zh: 我就像那种父母，总是把电视锁定在天气频道，你懂吗？

sentences.en: Well, Steve Burgess, you know, you're my favorite fella who loves to take sunset photos by the lake.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·伯吉斯，你知道的，你是我最喜欢的那种喜欢在湖边拍日落照片的家伙。

sentences.en: He gave me all the call sheets for season nine.
sentences.zh: 他给了我第九季所有的通告单。

sentences.en: I have all of them, lady.
I need everyone to know that the first day of filming happened on August 13th, 2012.
sentences.zh: 我需要让大家都知道，拍摄的第一天是2012年8月13日。

sentences.en: It continued into the high 90s for the rest of the week.
sentences.zh: 那一周剩下的时间里，气温持续在90多度。

sentences.en: The one other thing I want to share with you guys, I'm going to put this in stories as well.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事我想和大家分享，我也会把它发到快拍里。

sentences.en: These call sheets for Andy's ancestry were so heavy with special announcements for all of the meetings they had to take for work bus the next week.
sentences.zh: 安迪寻根那一集的通告单上，写满了接下来一周工作巴士的所有会议特别通知。

sentences.en: While we were shooting this, they were prepping that.
sentences.zh: 我们在拍这一集的时候，他们正在筹备那一集。

sentences.en: In fact, they just started putting buses on all the call sheets, like little images of buses.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们刚开始在所有的通告单上放巴士的图案，就像小小的巴士图片一样。

sentences.en: So, I'll share that in stories.
sentences.zh: 所以，我会把它分享在快拍里。

sentences.en: And then I will have a few get-to-know-your-cast-and-crew moments coming up.
sentences.zh: 接下来我会有一些了解演职人员的环节。

sentences.en: Well, fast fact number one, Angela, is that we had a very special guest star on this episode.
sentences.zh: 好吧，安吉拉，第一个小知识是，我们这一集有一位非常特别的客串明星。
出现在我们的开场戏里。

sentences.en: You might recognize Randall from Fresh Off the Boat or WandaVision.
sentences.zh: 你可能从《初来乍到》或《旺达幻视》里认出兰道尔。

sentences.en: You know, the New Yorker did a fantastic profile on him last year.
sentences.zh: 你知道，《纽约客》去年对他做了一篇非常棒的人物专访。

sentences.en: So, last year, Randall Park directed a film called Shortcomings.
sentences.zh: 去年，兰道尔·朴执导了一部名为《短comings》的电影。

sentences.en: It's based on the graphic novel by Adrienne Tomina.
sentences.zh: 它改编自阿德里安·托米内的同名图像小说。

sentences.en: You know that I went through a nerd out time in my life where I was super into graphic novels.
sentences.zh: 你知道我人生中曾有一段书呆子时期，那时我超级迷恋图像小说。

sentences.en: I love Adrienne Tomina so much.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢阿德里安·托米内。

sentences.en: So, this whole New Yorker profile was kind of around this subject.
sentences.zh: 所以，这篇《纽约客》的专访基本上就是围绕这个主题展开的。

sentences.en: So, anyway, give it a read.
I'll find it and put it in stories.
sentences.zh: 我会找到它并把它发到快拍里。

sentences.en: So, Randall also did an interview for NPR where he said that despite the popularity of Fresh
sentences.zh: 兰道尔还接受了美国国家公共电台的采访，他说尽管《初来乍到》

sentences.en: Off the Boat and WandaVision and being part of that world, the two things that he gets
sentences.zh: 和《旺达幻视》很受欢迎，他也身处那个世界之中，但他被认出次数最多的

sentences.en: recognized for the most are for playing Kim Jong-un in the movie The Interview and for The Office.
sentences.zh: 两件事，分别是出演电影《采访》中的金正恩，以及出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: Those are the things people yell out to him on the street.
sentences.zh: 那是人们在街上对他大喊大叫时提到的内容。

sentences.en: But he said for a period of time, he actually forgot that he had been on The Office.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，有一段时间，他甚至忘记了自己曾经出演过《办公室》。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, because he's gone on to do so many things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是啊，因为他后来做了很多事情。

sentences.en: And that people shout out to him on the street and he was confused.
sentences.zh: 而且人们在街上对他大喊大叫，他当时很困惑。

sentences.en: He actually told the story to Conan O'Brien and I have an audio clip.
sentences.zh: 他实际上把这个故事告诉了柯南·奥布莱恩，我有一段音频剪辑。

sentences.en: You did a role on The Office and when I heard about this, I thought, oh, okay, well, maybe
sentences.zh: 你在《办公室》里演过一个角色，当我听说这件事时，我想，哦，好吧，也许

sentences.en: you had an arc on The Office.
sentences.zh: 你在《办公室》里有一段剧情线。

sentences.en: You were barely in The Office.
sentences.zh: 你几乎没怎么在《办公室》里出现过。
然后他们发现了那个角色。

sentences.en: So, this was like many years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以，那是很多年前的事了。

sentences.en: It was the final season of The Office.
sentences.zh: 那是《办公室》的最后一季。

sentences.en: I got the chance to play a character named Asian Jim in like one scene during the final
sentences.zh: 我有机会在最后一季的一个场景里扮演了一个叫“亚洲吉姆”的角色。
当时，你知道，这部剧的人气已经开始下滑了。

sentences.en: And at that point, you know, the popularity of the show had been waning.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我进去拍了一个小时就出来了，我觉得那真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was in and out in an hour and I thought that was really fun.
sentences.zh: 然后我就，我完全把它忘了。

sentences.en: And then I just kind of, I completely forgot about it.
sentences.zh: 然后几年后，我走在街上，一辆车开过去，

sentences.en: And then several years later, I'm like walking down the street and this car drives by and
sentences.zh: 一个人大喊“亚洲吉姆”，然后就开走了。

sentences.en: a guy yells like Asian Jim and drives off.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，这是什么我不知道的种族歧视梗吗？

sentences.en: And I like, I'm thinking like, is this some like racist thing that I don't know about?
sentences.zh: 要么是粉丝认出了你，要么就是仇恨犯罪。

sentences.en: Either you, either a fan just saw you or it's a hate crime.
sentences.zh: 我以为是仇恨犯罪，你知道，因为我忘了自己曾在《办公室》里客串过。

sentences.en: I thought it was a hate crime, you know, because I had forgotten about my appearance on The Office.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，人们会走过来对我说，嘿，亚洲吉姆，怎么样？

sentences.en: And, you know, people would be walking up to me like, what's up, Asian Jim?

sentences.zh: 就像是，你到底在干嘛，你知道，然后。

sentences.en: That's like, what are you, you know, and then.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我想为你今天来到演播室时我那样打招呼道歉。

sentences.en: By the way, I want to apologize for greeting you when you came here to the studio today.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你当时就是那样的反应。

sentences.en: You know, and you went like that.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我确实那样做了，无所谓啦。

sentences.en: Yeah, I did that and whatever.
sentences.zh: 我是说，伙计，我当时确实越界了。

sentences.en: I mean, man, I was way out of bounds.

sentences.zh: 你有没有做过什么事，后来忘了，结果又被提醒了？

sentences.en: Have you ever done something that you forgot and then you were reminded later?

sentences.zh: 我当时在大学里做问答环节，有一群大学生。

sentences.en: I was actually doing a Q&A at a university and there's a bunch of college kids.

sentences.zh: 每个人都有关于《办公室》的问题。

sentences.en: Everyone had questions about The Office.
sentences.zh: 然后有个男生举手说，我没有问题，只是想说我最喜欢的台词。

sentences.en: And then this one guy raised his hand and said, I don't have a question, just my favorite quote.
sentences.zh: 所以我以为会是《办公室》里的台词。

sentences.en: So I thought it was going to be from The Office.
sentences.zh: 结果他引用了我在《奥兰多辣妻》里的角色台词。

sentences.en: And he quoted my character from Hot Wives of Orlando.
And I was clearly confused at firSt.
And then he was like, Hot Wives of Orlando.
I was like, oh, yes, right.

sentences.zh: 好吧，我们有一个来自克劳迪娅·L的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: Well, we had a fan question from Claudia L.
in Miami, Florida, who said, please tell us how it was working with Randall Park.
sentences.zh: 来自佛罗里达州迈阿密的观众问，请告诉我们和兰道尔·朴合作是什么感觉。

sentences.en: You know what, Claudia, it's what he said.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，克劳迪娅，就像他所说的那样。

sentences.en: We allotted one hour for that cold open.
sentences.zh: 我们当时只给那个开场戏预留了一个小时。

sentences.en: I barely met him before I smooched him.
sentences.zh: 我还没怎么跟他认识，就跟他亲上了。

sentences.en: You know, he was so nice, but it was just like a very kind of like professional moment, really.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他人非常好，但那真的只是一个非常职业化的瞬间。

sentences.en: And we shot those cold opens really quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们拍那些开场戏拍得非常快。

sentences.en: And this cold open has become one of the most famous, most popular.
sentences.zh: 而这个开场戏后来成了最出名、最受欢迎的片段之一。

sentences.en: But for us, it was like one hour of our work day.
sentences.zh: 但对我们来说，那只是我们工作日里的一小时而已。

sentences.en: We had no idea that it would take off the way it did or that Randall Park would take off the way he did.
sentences.zh: 我们当时根本没想到它会这么火，也没想到兰道尔·朴会这么火。

sentences.en: He was lovely and funny and ready to go.
sentences.zh: 他可爱、幽默，而且随时准备开工。

sentences.en: You know, all the best things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，具备了所有最好的特质。

sentences.en: I'm so thankful I got to work with Randall again because I played Amy Chestnut in Fresh Off the Boat.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸能再次与兰道尔合作，因为我在《初来乍到》里饰演过艾米·切斯纳特。

sentences.en: And we had a few episodes together.
We had some great scenes where we were on a double date.
sentences.zh: 我们有一些很棒的对手戏，当时我们在进行双重约会。

sentences.en: And we were laughing so hard.
sentences.zh: 我们当时笑得特别厉害。

sentences.en: And they let us improvise a little.
sentences.zh: 他们还让我们即兴发挥了一点。

sentences.en: And I really enjoyed my time on that show and really enjoyed working with him.
sentences.zh: 我非常享受在那部剧里的时光，也非常享受与他共事。

sentences.en: Are you ready for Fast Fact number two?
sentences.zh: 准备好迎接第二个速览事实了吗？

sentences.en: This is a fan question from Selena P.
sentences.zh: 这是一个来自亚利桑那州钱德勒市的粉丝塞琳娜·P提出的问题，

sentences.en: in Chandler, Arizona, who has a question about our Season 9 set.
sentences.zh: 她对我们第九季的片场有疑问。

sentences.en: Selena said, whose decision was it to change the lighting of The Office?
sentences.zh: 塞琳娜问，改变《办公室》的灯光是谁的决定？

sentences.en: Season 9 is so much brighter than the rest of the series.
sentences.zh: 第九季比该剧的其他部分亮多了。
我一直很想知道为什么。

sentences.en: Well, Selena, I reached out to Greg Daniels.
sentences.zh: 嗯，塞琳娜，我联系了格雷格·丹尼尔斯。

sentences.en: And he said that Dave Rogers, our editor, and subsequently the director of this episode,
sentences.zh: 他说我们的剪辑师，后来也是这一集的导演戴夫·罗杰斯，

sentences.en: had been complaining for a couple of years that the lighting seemed to be getting darker and darker.
sentences.zh: 已经抱怨了好几年，说灯光似乎变得越来越暗了。

sentences.en: And so they had a big meeting about it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们为此开了一个大会。

sentences.en: And they actually felt that the lighting this season was more of a restoration of our original look.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上觉得这一季的灯光更像是对我们最初视觉风格的还原。

sentences.en: They did bump up the lighting, Selena.
sentences.zh: 他们确实调亮了灯光，塞琳娜。

sentences.en: I'm so impressed that you recognized this.
sentences.zh: 你能注意到这一点，我印象太深刻了。

sentences.en: I kind of want to do a side-by-side.
sentences.zh: 我有点想做一个对比图。

sentences.en: I'll also tell you, Selena, that after I had my baby, I got a bunch of melasma on my face,
sentences.zh: 我还要告诉你，塞琳娜，我生完孩子后，脸上长了很多黄褐斑，
你知道，就是那些深色斑点。

sentences.en: And they were having a really hard time because the lighting in our office wasn't traditional
sentences.zh: 他们当时非常头疼，因为我们办公室的灯光不是传统的

sentences.en: kind of movie lighting where they light the actors from the front.
sentences.zh: 那种从正面给演员打光的电影灯光。

sentences.en: Everyone looks like they're a cryptkeeper or something.
sentences.zh: 每个人看起来都像守墓人什么的。

sentences.en: And it was actually that overhead lighting was enhancing these melasma spots on my face.
sentences.zh: 实际上是因为头顶的灯光加重了我脸上的黄褐斑。

sentences.en: And the makeup department literally couldn't put more makeup on my face.
sentences.zh: 化妆组简直没法再往我脸上涂更多化妆品了。

sentences.en: If you notice that Pam's makeup is a little heavier in season nine, it's because of this melasma.
sentences.zh: 如果你注意到帕姆在第九季的妆容稍微厚重了一些，就是因为这个黄褐斑。

sentences.en: And actually bumping up the lighting helped with that.
sentences.zh: 其实调高灯光亮度对改善这个问题有帮助。

sentences.en: I had to do a bunch of test lighting days.
sentences.zh: 我不得不参加了好几次灯光测试。

sentences.en: They would combine certain makeup with certain lighting.
sentences.zh: 他们会把特定的妆容和特定的灯光结合起来。

sentences.en: And they ended up creating a little tiny, like, portable light box that would sit on my desk
sentences.zh: 最后他们做了一个小小的、便携式的灯箱放在我的桌子上，

sentences.en: and shine on my face from below to help counteract the shadows from our overhead lighting system.
sentences.zh: 从下方照向我的脸，以抵消头顶照明系统产生的阴影。

sentences.en: And then the makeup department tried a bunch of things.
sentences.zh: 然后化妆组尝试了很多种方法。

sentences.en: But, yeah, there was a bunch of new lighting stuff happening in season nine.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，第九季确实有很多新的灯光调整。

sentences.en: I mean, I know we don't want to go off on this tangent, but just the things women's bodies go through to have a baby.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我知道我们不想扯远，但女性为了生孩子身体要经历这么多变化。

sentences.en: The spots on the face that have never gone away from me.
sentences.zh: 我脸上的斑点一直没消掉。

sentences.en: They've lightened now over the years.
sentences.zh: 这些年来它们变淡了一些。

sentences.en: But, you know, then I had another baby and then hello again.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，后来我又生了一个孩子，然后它们又回来了。

sentences.en: And then where's my little box lamp?
sentences.zh: 那么我的小灯箱在哪呢？

sentences.en: At that point, I was off the office.
sentences.zh: 那时候我已经离开《办公室》了。

sentences.en: I travel with a box lamp.
I'll have you know this episode was very well received by critics.
sentences.zh: 我要告诉你，这一集受到了评论家们的高度评价。

sentences.en: The new critic over at the AV Club, Eric Adams, gave it a B.
sentences.zh: AV Club的新评论家埃里克·亚当斯给了它B的评分。

sentences.en: I did not see any comments from Miles.
sentences.zh: 我没看到迈尔斯的任何评论。

sentences.en: I looked through all the comments.
Mark Trammell of TV Equals named it, quote,
sentences.zh: TV Equals的马克·特拉梅尔称其为，引用：

sentences.en: the best episode of the final season of The Office to date.
sentences.zh: “《办公室》最终季迄今为止最好的一集”。
